page.overview:
What is Baby Crawler?

The s are minor antagonists in Five Nights at Freddy's: The Fourth Closet. They serve as the alternate counterparts of the Bidybabs from Sister Location and one of the mascots at Circus Baby's Pizza.

The Baby Crawlers are small, baby-like animatronics made of metal with plastic faces painted like clowns and greatly exaggerated features. One has a round, red nose that covers half its face and a white wig of synthetic curls. Another has a molded smile on its face and a painted red grimace. A third, a red-cheeked, smiling clown with a rainbow-colored wig, has a gigantic spring that replaces the middle of its torso, bouncing up and down each time it moves. All of the crawlers have black eyes, with no iris or pupil. They also have two rows of pointy teeth.

Three different types of Baby Crawlers are first seen in Chapter 12 after Marla and Carlton arrive at Circus Baby's Pizza. They're seen playing on the monkey bars of a jungle gym in the dinning room. The crawlers don't see Carlton and Marla because of the illusionary devices in their ears.

In Chapter 13, Marla and Jessica leads the missing children to the dining room, where two of the Baby Crawlers are still playing on the monkey bars. While they can't see Marla and Jessica due to the devices, they can see the children, as the third manages to bite Alanna. The two on the bars begin to approach Lisa and Ron, and the third corners them. While Marla goes to protect Lisa and Alanna, Jessica picks one up and throws it into a four or five feet deep ball pit. Marla, although hesitant at first, helps. Meanwhile, Carlton encounters a deactivated crawler while crawling through the Hide-and-Seek Hallway.
